title: Implement graceful shutdown endpoint to prevent GPU hangs
description:
Problem: restart-worker.sh uses pkill which doesn't allow proper GPU cleanup, causing D-state hangs.

Solution: 
- Added POST /shutdown endpoint in worker/app.py
- Endpoint cancels running jobs and unloads all models
- restart-worker.sh now calls /shutdown before pkill
- Falls back to SIGTERM -> SIGKILL if API fails

Files modified:
- src/mydiffuser/worker/app.py (new /shutdown endpoint)
- scripts/restart-worker.sh (call API before pkill)
- GPU_HANG_RECOVERY.md (documentation)

Status: Implemented, ready for testing

title: Fix GPU hang during worker startup
description:
GPU detection in config.py can hang when GPU is in D-state.

Root cause: GPU detection runs at module import time, calling torch.cuda functions that hang if GPU is unresponsive.

Fix:
- Add MYDIFFUSER_SKIP_GPU_DETECT check before calling _detect_gpu_info()
- Improve error handling in _detect_gpu_info()
- Make detection more defensive

Files: src/mydiffuser/config.py

title: Replace hardcoded estimates with data-driven predictions
description:

- Fit polynomial: time = base + pixel_factor * pixels^0.85 + step_factor * steps

- Background training job (every 10 runs or daily)
- Fall back to hardcoded if <5 samples

title: Improve restart-worker.sh GPU health checks
description:
Restart script can hang waiting for GPU memory to stabilize if GPU enters D-state.

Improvements:
- Check GPU health with rocminfo BEFORE memory wait
- Re-check GPU health AFTER memory wait
- Both checks have 5-second timeout
- Exit immediately with clear error if GPU hung

Prevents: Hanging during restart if GPU becomes unresponsive.

Files: scripts/restart-worker.sh
